name: Library
full_text: Fistandia's working library. Tall shelves line the walls; two freestanding shelf sections run through the middle with a 10-foot-wide aisle between them. Stacks of books are piled throughout. Reading desks with scarlet chairs sit in the corners. Subjects on the shelves: arcana, natural science, religion, astrology, planar travel, poetry, mythology, folk tales. One book pile is actually a swarm of animated books that ambushes the party by toppling a 10-ft freestanding shelf onto them. A jeweled letter opener (20 gp) sits on a reading desk. The lettered puzzle book bearing R is somewhere on the shelves.
summary: Fistandia's main library; concealed swarm of animated books ambushes via toppling bookshelf; contains the R puzzle book and a 20 gp jeweled letter opener.
